listing.description:
Tend is an undated self-care planner for your tablet that stays small on purpose: one gentle page a week, a journal prompt for every week, and a few kind tools for the days you need them. Start any day, in any month.

What's inside: 130 landscape pages in one PDF
- Cover and a Contents page that shows every section on one screen
- Start here: 4 numbered steps (steps 2 to 4 have a Go there button that opens their page) and a map of the top bar
- Setup check: tap the buttons to test the links on your own device, with a fix list if one does not jump
- 52 weeks overview: a card for every week, tap to open it
- 52 week pages: dates, a row for each day (mood, energy, sleep, one kind thing for me, done), 5 gentle habits with 2 rows of your own, mood this week, hours of rest, what helped and what you need next week
- Journal index: all 52 prompts on one page, tap a week to open its journal page
- 52 journal pages, one for each week, each with its own printed prompt, space for your answer, three small good things and a kind word to myself
- Self-care menu: 20 ideas sorted by time (5 minutes, 15 minutes, an hour, a slow day) with blank rows for your own
- Energy map: what drains me, what fills me back up, boundaries I want to keep
- Hard day plan: the smallest steps already written, people I can reach, small things that help
- Year in moods: one square per day to color, a Year to ____ line for a year that starts mid-way, a color key, how to color and space for moments to remember
- 13 undated month pages (January to December plus Month 13, for a year that starts mid-month): how I want to feel, best and hardest day, 4 habit rows with a circle for each day, a mood square for each day and a monthly reflection
- 3 dot grid notes pages

Good to know: a digital PDF for note apps on a tablet. Landscape only, undated, in English. No stickers. It is not a fillable form: write with your pen or type with your app's text tool.

What makes it different
- Small on purpose. One week page and one journal page a week, so nothing piles up when you skip a few days.
- A prompt for every week. 52 different questions, so you never stare at a blank page.
- One tap between pages. Each week page opens its journal page and the self-care menu, and the journal has a Week button back. The top bar's Journal button opens the journal index. Each week's journal page sits right after it, so you can swipe through one week at a time.
- Ready for hard days. Fill in the hard day plan on a good day, so it is there when you need it.
- Start any day. No dates are printed, so it works whenever you begin and again next year.
- Working in five minutes. The Open planner button on the cover takes you to Start here, and the Setup check page shows the links work before you write anything.
- Easy to get around: month tabs on every page, a top bar for Home, Weeks, Journal, Menu, Energy, Hard day and Moods, and on every page arrows and a trail at the top right that works as a back button.
- A quiet dusk look: warm cream pages, deep plum text, peach and lavender tabs.

Works with
- Goodnotes, Notability, Samsung Notes, Xodo and Noteshelf
- on iPad, Android tablets and Windows tablets
You need a PDF note app like one of these to tap the links and write on the pages.

Not for
- Phones: the pages are tablet size
- Files, Photos and other file viewers: they show the pages but do not follow the links
- Canva, spreadsheets or fillable forms: this is a PDF you write on by hand or with your app's text tool

How to start
1. Download the file from Etsy in a web browser. The Etsy app cannot download digital files.
2. Open the PDF in your note app and import it as a PDF.
3. Tap the Setup check buttons, then open Week 1, write the dates and fill in today's row.

Questions buyers ask
- The Etsy app won't download it. Use a web browser (Safari, Chrome) and go to Purchases. The Etsy app cannot download digital files.
- Which app do I need? A PDF note app: Goodnotes, Notability, Samsung Notes, Xodo or Noteshelf.
- The links don't tap. Turn the pen off (read or view mode). The Setup check page tests this in seconds.
- Can I type in it? Yes, with your app's text tool. It isn't a fillable form, so there are no typing boxes.
- Is it a therapy workbook? No. It is a planner and journal for everyday self-care, not medical or mental health advice.

What you get
- Tend.pdf (3.2 MB, 130 pages, landscape)
One PDF, not a zip, so it downloads and imports quickly.
Digital download. Nothing is shipped.

Help
The Setup check page has a fix list. Still stuck? Send the shop an Etsy message.
